title: The Good Samaritan
reflectionQuestion: When has someone been kind to you when you needed them?
kidSafetyNotes: SUPERSEDES legacy kid_1005_neighbor_short. Robbery softened ('they hurt the man, and took all his things, and left him lying'); no blood/weapons. Care detailed gently (oil, cloth, cool water - Luke 10:34). Adam-locked ending kept verbatim: Jesus 'Now you know... Go and do the same' (the one story where an explicit do-this is faithful to the parable's point). One image: the Samaritan kneeling in the dust.
